_instructions: For each question set answer to YES, NO, PARTIAL, UNCLEAR or UNANSWERED and paste the provider's own words into excerpt. Fill commercial values as text with units (e.g. '£0.50/number/month at 1k'). Leave blank if not given.

AQL-1.q: Do programmable diversion / number-level routing / mobile-core routing apply to calls to a number that STAYS on EE, O2, Vodafone or Three, before that network delivers or forwards them?

AQL-2.q: For aql/BlueWave SIMs, can the core make a per-call decision before the handset rings (IMS AS via iFC, SIP 3xx, HTTP/ENUM lookup to HCG)?

AQL-3.q: On 'deliver', is the trusted call delivered natively with no media through HCG or aql's platform and no per-minute charge to HCG?

AQL-4.q: Can consumers port an existing EE/O2/Vodafone/Three 07 number to an aql SIM (PAC / text-to-switch)?

AQL-5.q: Do aql SIMs support VoLTE and Wi-Fi Calling on iPhone and Android (Apple carrier settings for your PLMN)?

AQL-6.q: Will aql supply SIMs for HCG to retail to consumers under HCG's brand, with default bars (premium, international, roaming) and per-SIM credit limits?

AQL-7.q: On Three (aql's radio host), does a SIP 486 or 603 from a declining VoLTE handset trigger Call Forwarding on Busy?

AQL-8.q: Free-inbound SIP DIDs for forwarded unknown calls, with per-DID channel caps and maximum call duration (C3)?

MAG-1.q: Will you host an HCG-owned Ofcom geographic range (block of 1,000), managed by API, with free inbound to our SIP endpoint?

MAG-2.q: Your price list shows 10 concurrent channels per number and free inbound: can the per-number cap be set lower (e.g. 2), is a maximum call duration enforceable on your side, and at what volume does free inbound end?

MAG-3.q: In Network Mode, do diverts from EE, O2, Vodafone and Three actually arrive with the original CLI plus the last diverted line identity (Diversion / LDLI)? Sample INVITE?

MAG-4.q: Can your platform ask our endpoint for a routing decision BEFORE answering and, on 'deliver to PSTN number X', leave the media path (no further leg billed to us)?

MAG-5.q: Your August 2026 newsletter mentions a mobile product in testing: what is it, when does it launch, and can you port in or host 07 mobile numbers (on SIM or VoIP)?

MAG-6.q: Can outbound calling be barred on our account (or limited to UK geographic/mobile) by you, independent of our API credentials?

TEL-1.q: Is channel billing available for UK (GB) numbers used with Call Control and WebRTC, and which per-minute fees (origination, Voice API, WebRTC, streaming) does it replace?

TEL-2.q: Is there any Call Control action after which Telnyx leaves both signalling and media of a PSTN-originated inbound call, with no further charge (e.g. refer)?

TEL-3.q: Can Telnyx Mobile Voice SIMs/eSIMs hold UK 07 numbers, including numbers ported from EE/O2/Vodafone/Three?

TEL-4.q: Does a Mobile Voice connection (e.g. the `inbound.interception_app_id` field in your MobilePhoneNumber API) call HCG BEFORE the SIM rings, letting HCG choose 'ring natively' or 'route to Call Control', with a fail-open default?

TEL-5.q: Is a natively-delivered incoming call to a Mobile Voice SIM free of per-minute charges to HCG, and do VoLTE and Wi-Fi Calling work on iPhone in the UK?

TEL-6.q: Does the Telnyx React Native SDK support iOS PushKit/CallKit and Android FCM incoming calls equivalent to Twilio <Dial><Client>?

TWI-1.q: Which product or carrier arrangement acts BEFORE the customer's own MNO delivers or forwards the call?

TWI-2.q: Is <Reject> as the first verb unbilled on calls that arrive by mobile-network conditional forwarding (CFB/CFNRy)?

TWI-3.q: Is ForwardedFrom (or any field) populated with the diverting subscriber number on CFB/CFNRy calls?

TWI-4.q: On BYOC-originated calls, is the Voice SDK <Client> leg billed, and at what rate? Is the £0 on our invoices permanent?

TWI-5.q: Can outbound voice/SMS geo permissions be locked against API change; per-number concurrency caps; hard spend stop on a subaccount?

TWI-6.q: For a dial-back of a screened call to the customer's mobile, may the caller ID be the original caller's number, or only an owned/verified number?
